headline: Vader lightsaber breaks Star Wars auction record
post:
The iconic lightsaber prop used by Darth Vader during that unforgettable father-son duel in The Empire Strikes Back just sold at auction for a staggering $4,875,000. Heritage reports that bidding has officially closed, making this incredible piece of cinema history the most expensive Star Wars collectible ever sold!

headline: Kevin Feige clarifies RDJ Doctor Doom status
post:
Big news for Marvel fans! According to /Film, Marvel Studios head Kevin Feige recently addressed whether Robert Downey Jr. is playing a Tony Stark variant in "Avengers: Doomsday". 

Feige indicated that the actor is playing an entirely different character, stating that he is Victor Von Doom and comparing the casting choice to Chris Evans playing both Johnny Storm and Steve Rogers. Meanwhile, directors Joe and Anthony Russo shared that this version of Doom is "a Gothic character" and "a very powerful character with some very dark magic", adding that he is a "father who's a victim of trauma" who has "lost a child". Downey Jr. described his role as a "scorched earth" mission, and mentioned having a "glorious time" playing the villain.

Do you think we will see any connection to Tony Stark? 

#AvengersDoomsday #DoctorDoom #MarvelStudios
original_title: Marvel Officially Confirms Whether RDJ's Doctor Doom Is A Tony Stark Variant

headline: Killer Croc's unexpected heroism in Batman Bad Seeds
post:
In the recent Batman: Bad Seeds crossover event, Killer Croc stepped up as a genuine hero for Gotham City. According to reports, Croc saved Batman from Poison Ivy's superbloom, rescued Ivy from Lady Jane, and ultimately decapitated Police Commissioner Vandal Savage in Batman: Bad Seeds - Sunrise #1 before fleeing into the sewers. 🐊

It is quite a shift to see his monstrous violence used to help others following his treatment with the Crown of Storms.

headline: Brainiac takes the ultimate DC title
post:
Hey everyone! Big changes are shaking up the comic world. According to Screen Rant, Brainiac has officially been given a brand new title a thousand years in the future.

In the pages of Legion of Super-Heroes #3, this version of Brainiac 5 works as a private investigator in the thirty-first century. Armed with a twelfth-level Coluan intellect, he earns the amazing distinction of being called the "Universe's Greatest Detective" while tracking down rebels and solving a high-profile murder.

Down in the main timeline, Bruce Wayne's exact retirement and death remain a complete mystery. Even with futuristic technology around, the true fate of the original Dark Knight stays locked away as he vanishes into legend. 🦇

Besides Batman, which DC character do you consider the World's Greatest Detective?

#DCComics #Brainiac #Batman
original_title: DC Officially Replaces Batman As Its 'Greatest Detective'
